info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Petadoption Pets Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Status Retrieval API facilitates easy access to the current status of pets available for adoption. This endpoint allows users to query the status of various pets, enabling potential adopters to check which animals are available, adopted, or on hold. It is particularly useful for shelters, rescue organizations, and prospective pet owners looking to streamline the adoption process. By using this API, stakeholders can ensure they have up-to-date information about pet availability, enhancing the overall adoption experience.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of all pets
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of all pets in the system. You can use this to check on the health, availability, or other pertinent information regarding the pets.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the status of the pets being queried. The client can define various parameters related to the status as outlined in the schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the status of pets.

ListPetadoptionPetsStatusRequest.description: This schema defines the request body for the GET operation on pet status. It is intended to represent the status as a string value.
